summary: Pre-market Monday, and the framing has to start with what is NOT new: the last completed US session is Friday's settled close, so every US equity, sector and volatility figure below is that session, not an overnight move. What is new is the discount-rate block. The newest FRED vintage, dated 2026-09-24, puts the 10-year at 5.18 from 5.11, the 2-year at 4.87 from 4.85 and the 10-year real rate at 2.85 from 2.76, with both the 10-year and the real rate at the 100.0th percentile of their own histories, yet the composite has added only 0.2 to 45.68 and the regime held at goldilocks. Asia is the second new input and it goes the other way: the tracked A-share AI panel closed all 11 names lower, worst 300475.sz at -7.6184 and 603986.sh at -6.5821, the mirror image of a US tape led by Semiconductor Equipment +1.7656, AI Infrastructure +1.7534 and Semiconductors +1.1677 with 12 of 22 sectors and themes positive. Beneath the index the internals softened: above MA200 0.5714, the new-lows ratio 0.0649, small-cap relative -11.7675 and semis relative -8.7365, and triggered cross-asset signals fell to 7 of 10 after copper flipped to -1.0231 and gold reversed to -3.0802. Crypto broke with the tone (BTC -2.26909 to 82876, SOL -4.3763). Volatility and credit still price nothing - VIX 14.21, realized volatility 10.7952, HY OAS 2.8 and IG OAS 0.79 - and policy remains priced for a hike, with the FedWatch-implied 4.2 above the effective 3.88 into the calendar's FOMC meeting tonight at 18:00Z. The pre-market question is whether the 10-year holds above 5.18, whether the CN de-rating transmits or decouples, and whether credit or volatility finally confirm.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The 10-year real rate rose to 2.85 from 2.76 and now sits at the 100.0th percentile of its own history, with the nominal 10-year at 5.18 from 5.11 (also the 100.0th percentile). The macro block is the binding constraint at a score of 67.8.

Cross-asset confirmation worsened: copper flipped to -1.0231 and gold reversed to -3.0802, cutting triggered signals to 7 of 10 and leaving the confirmation score at 0.625 with the cross-asset dimension flat at 50.0.
Breadth deteriorated beneath the index: only 0.5714 of the panel sits above MA200 (88 of 154 names) and the new-lows ratio reached 0.0649, against a new-highs ratio of 0.0455.

The tracked A-share AI panel closed all 11 names lower, led by 300475.sz at -7.6184, 603986.sh at -6.5821 and 688525.sh at -6.0471 - the sharpest single-session CN de-rating in this series and the mirror image of the US hardware bid.
Crypto broke with the risk tone: BTC fell -2.26909 to 82876 while SOL fell -4.3763, keeping the bitcoin-down cross-asset signal triggered.

supporting_signals.claim: Leadership stayed narrow: small-cap relative sits at -11.7675 and semis relative at -8.7365, so the index-level bid is not broad.
The trend block kept falling, with 3-month momentum at 5.8108 and the 52-week drawdown at -0.8395, adding to the caution read.
Policy is still priced for tightening: the FedWatch-implied 4.2 sits above the effective 3.88 with the action flag set to hike, into the calendar's FOMC meeting tonight.
The yen weakened to 156.87 from 155.85, a move that keeps FX intervention risk in play given the press focus on the 160 handle.
The liquidity cushion is thin on the latest H.4.1 vintage: bank reserves fell to 2930193 from 3013794 while the Treasury General Account rebuilt to 977084 from 877028, and reverse repo sits at 0.576.

contradicting_signals.claim: The composite added 0.2 to 45.68 and the regime held at goldilocks, so nothing in the risk model has broken yet.
Volatility still prices nothing: VIX at 14.21 sits in the 15.56th percentile and realized volatility is 10.7952.
Credit is still untroubled at HY OAS 2.8 and IG OAS 0.79, well inside their own recent ranges.
The US hardware complex held up: 12 of 22 sectors and themes closed higher, led by Semiconductor Equipment +1.7656, AI Infrastructure +1.7534 and Semiconductors +1.1677.
The dollar at 119.5133 sits only in the 30.09th percentile, one of the few macro inputs still far from a cycle extreme.

what_changed_today: The rates vintage advanced to 2026-09-24: the 10-year moved to 5.18 from 5.11, the 2-year to 4.87 from 4.85 and the real rate to 2.85 from 2.76.
Breakevens edged up with the nominal move (5-year 2.34 from 2.33, 10-year 2.34 from 2.33), so the real-rate rise is only partly an inflation-expectation story.
Breadth softened: only 0.5714 of names sit above MA200 (88 of 154) and the new-lows ratio reached 0.0649 (10 names) against a new-highs ratio of 0.0455 (7 names).
The A-share close was the largest new input: all 11 tracked names fell, with the range running from -2.7506 at 688008.sh down to -7.6184 at 300475.sz.
The FedWatch-implied rate edged up to 4.2 from 4.175 with the action flag still set to hike.
Crypto deepened its decline: BTC fell -2.26909 to 82876, ETH fell -1.99981 and SOL fell -4.3763.
watch_next: The calendar's high-importance FOMC meeting at 2026-09-28T18:00Z is tonight's event risk, with the implied 4.2 still above the effective 3.88.
Whether the 10-year holds above 5.18 and the real rate above 2.85, or mean-reverts now that both sit at the top of their distributions.
Whether credit or volatility finally confirm: HY OAS 2.8, IG OAS 0.79 and VIX 14.21 are all still priced for calm.
Whether the CN de-rating transmits into the US hardware complex or stays a decoupled, Asia-local event.
This week's US data run (job openings on 2026-09-29, personal income and GDP on 2026-09-30, employment situation on 2026-10-02) against press framing that it reinforces the case for another hike.
How much energy premium the Hormuz headlines add back, and whether the diesel-export debate opens a second supply channel.

bull_case.title: Volatility and credit hold the line
points: Credit and volatility keep pricing calm (HY OAS 2.8, IG OAS 0.79, VIX 14.21) while the real rate mean-reverts from 2.85, easing the binding constraint without any policy move.
An energy-premium unwind after the Hormuz headlines lowers the inflation impulse and lets the front end lead a curve rally.
The composite holds at 45.68 with 12 of 22 sectors and themes still advancing and the weekly trend at 0.59.

base_case.title: Narrow tape, high discount rate, no break
points: The composite stays in a narrow band around 45.68 while the macro block pins the real rate near 2.85 and the 10-year near 5.18.
Asia and the US keep running independently, with the A-share panel's all 11 names falling without transmitting into US hardware.
Volatility and credit stay quiet into the FOMC, and the energy impulse remains a headline rather than a broad inflation input.

bear_case.title: The long end breaks the equity bid
points: The 10-year extends beyond 5.18 and the real rate beyond 2.85, and the stretched leadership (small-cap relative -11.7675, semis relative -8.7365) rolls over.
Credit finally follows and the corporate-spread signal flips out of dormancy, while volatility leaves its 14.21 base.
The CN de-rating transmits through the hardware complex, turning the all 11 A-share names falling into a global AI-capex signal rather than a local one.
